structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions
State Board for Community Colleges and Virginia Community College System

law.text:
Each comprehensive community college shall:
Maximize noncredit course offerings made available to business and industry at a time and place that meet current and projected workforce needs and minimize the cost of noncredit offerings to business and industry to the extent feasible;
Deal directly with employers in designing and offering courses to meet real, current, and projected workforce training needs; and
Maximize the availability and use of distance learning courses addressing workforce training needs.
